# ECRP Fixtures

Fixtures for ECRP Retry/Replan Contract v1. They prove bounded failure evidence and invalid recovery claims, not successful recovery, physical truth, HIL support, or hardware attestation.

`policy_simulated_recovery_success.json` and paired HAIL/trace fixtures cover the simulator-only transient DMF retry path. They do not claim hardware recovery, HIL support, sensor attestation, or physical truth.
